svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Estimated number of farms by size based on agricultural census data. Shown is the year of the latest agricultural
census data, which varies from country to country.

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2002 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1992 and 2005 is shown instead.
